description_en: Retrieves the task details for MiaoSou search generation tasks
description_zh: 查询妙搜搜索生成任务详情列表
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi list-search-task-dialogues --workspace-id xxxx --page-size 10 --task-id xxxx --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSearchTaskDialogues

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the Model Studio workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the task.

> You do not need to specify this parameter. The system generates it automatically. If you specify the same TaskId for multiple tasks, they are grouped into the same conversation
parameters.help_zh:
任务唯一标识
> TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话。
>
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number
